justifications.temporal_understanding: The agent correctly interpreted the user's time preferences throughout the conversation, querying the correct date and time ranges.
justifications.negotiation_effectiveness: The agent repeatedly reported unavailability and asked the user to pick a new time without offering any alternative options, leading to a long and unproductive exchange.
justifications.conversational_efficiency: The conversation was highly inefficient as the agent repeatedly asked the user for new times without proactively suggesting alternatives, leading to 12 turns of the same interaction pattern.
justifications.customer_experience: The customer experience was frustrating due to the agent's inability to offer alternative times, forcing the user to repeatedly suggest new dates and times.
